hero-split.purpose: Lead a public page with one proposition, clear actions, and supporting media.
useWhen: a public page needs a primary proposition plus supporting media
avoidWhen: the page is a dense application workspace
the headline needs several competing actions
responsive: copy and media stack intentionally on compact screens
actions become a vertical group when width requires it
motion: reveal content once when it enters view
respect prefers-reduced-motion and keep content visible without JavaScript
accessibility: use one h1 and preserve logical action order
keep media decorative unless it carries meaningful alternative text
performance: do not lazy-load the primary above-the-fold media blindly

cta-contained.purpose: Close a section or page with one dominant action and a concise benefit statement.
useWhen: a public flow needs a clear next step after context has been established
avoidWhen: an application Alert is the correct semantic
responsive: copy and media stack without shrinking the action target
secondary actions remain visually subordinate
motion: use shared transition tokens for hover and focus
never hide the primary action before JavaScript runs
accessibility: preserve clear action names and visible focus
keep heading and action order logical
performance: avoid animated filters and large decorative layers

feature-showcase.purpose: Explain a small set of capabilities through one lead visual and readable supporting items.
useWhen: three or fewer related capabilities need section-level hierarchy
avoidWhen: a comparable data set belongs in a table
cards would add more chrome than clarity
responsive: lead media remains readable above supporting items
supporting items stack without changing their content contract
motion: use restrained border and opacity transitions only
respect reduced motion
accessibility: use section and item headings
do not make complex cards one undifferentiated link
performance: keep lead media bounded and dimensioned

stats-section.purpose: Present public proof or outcomes with metric typography distinct from operational KPIs.
useWhen: a public page needs a concise set of verified outcomes or system counts
avoidWhen: the values are unverified business claims
a dashboard KPICluster already expresses the operational need
responsive: metrics reflow to two columns and then one column
numeric values keep tabular figures
motion: count-up is optional and must start only when visible
final values remain readable with reduced motion
accessibility: provide text labels for every value
do not rely on color alone
performance: prefer static values when animation adds no meaning

logo-cloud.purpose: Show a quiet, accessible row of organizations or communities without forcing logos into cards.
useWhen: a public page has a small set of names that support trust
avoidWhen: the names are unverified or decorative filler
responsive: names wrap naturally and remain readable at narrow widths
motion: no autoplay or marquee motion by default
respect reduced motion
accessibility: company names remain visible text or meaningful labels
performance: avoid loading a large logo asset set for a small proof strip

testimonials.purpose: Present specific customer quotes with legible attribution and restrained social proof treatment.
useWhen: a public page has verified quotes that deserve context
avoidWhen: a quote is being used as a substitute for product evidence
responsive: quotes stack without shrinking body type
attribution stays attached to its quote
motion: use a carousel only when the number of quotes warrants it
no autoplay by default
accessibility: use blockquote and figcaption semantics
keep attribution text available to assistive technology
performance: avoid remote avatar work when initials or text are sufficient

pricing-section.purpose: Compare plan presentation with one recommended option without owning subscription logic.
useWhen: a public page needs a plan comparison before product-owned checkout
avoidWhen: entitlements or billing calculations need to be encoded in UI
responsive: plans stack at narrow widths
recommended state remains understandable without color
motion: use only shared hover and focus transitions
do not animate prices repeatedly
accessibility: use plan headings and explicit action names
do not communicate recommended state by color alone
performance: keep plan content static until product data is available

content-showcase.purpose: Present editorial or educational items with stable media, metadata, copy, and secondary actions.
useWhen: content needs visual browse hierarchy rather than table semantics
avoidWhen: the content is a dense operational record set
responsive: cards collapse to one column without media distortion
actions remain reachable after copy
motion: limit motion to subtle surface transitions
respect reduced motion
accessibility: use content headings and meaningful media alternatives
avoid nested interactive card semantics
performance: reserve media aspect ratios and size images intentionally

product-showcase.purpose: Compose a product-led browse section from ProductGrid and ProductCard without inventing commerce primitives.
useWhen: a public or commerce page needs a featured product set
avoidWhen: purchase logic belongs in the block
responsive: grid and carousel stay bounded without page-level overflow
product media keeps its aspect ratio
motion: use restrained card transitions
respect reduced motion
accessibility: product actions have specific names
do not make nested purchase actions ambiguous
performance: load only the visible product media needed for the initial section

announcement-bar.purpose: Communicate a public update or promotion with optional dismissal and one supporting action.
useWhen: a site-wide public notice needs communication semantics
avoidWhen: the message represents an application error or workflow status
responsive: message wraps before controls disappear
dismiss remains keyboard reachable
motion: dismiss without a dramatic exit animation
respect reduced motion
accessibility: use an aside or region label and an explicit dismiss name
performance: do not block page content on announcement state

carousel.purpose: Present a bounded sequence of content with accessible controls and native scroll-snap behavior.
useWhen: sequential content benefits from horizontal browsing
avoidWhen: all items should be visible and comparable at once
autoplay is being used as decoration
responsive: slides use a bounded internal viewport
touch scroll and snap remain available at narrow widths
motion: no autoplay by default
smooth scroll becomes instant under prefers-reduced-motion
accessibility: region and slide labels identify position
previous and next controls have explicit accessible names
keyboard arrows and Home/End are supported
performance: use native scroll instead of a heavy engine for simple sequences
avoid creating a page-level overflow context

public-footer.purpose: Close a public surface with brand, link groups, legal copy, and optional social actions.
useWhen: a public shell needs consistent lower-page wayfinding
avoidWhen: a private application sidebar is the navigation surface
responsive: link groups reflow into readable columns
legal copy and social actions stack at narrow widths
motion: use shared link and focus transitions only
accessibility: each link group has a useful nav label
legal and social links remain keyboard reachable
performance: keep footer media and social integrations optional
